summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. 18 rows map 1:1 to the 18 deposited RAW files; 3 conditions x 3 biological replicates x 2 injections matches the paper's n=18 LC runs. Cell line metadata matches Cellosaurus CVCL_0546; MS1 scan range 400-1400 m/z, Q Exactive HF and HCD were confirmed from the instrument method in two RAW headers. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; no producer transcript, report.md or prior review verdicts read

spec_compliance.evidence: I derived the active templates as ms-proteomics + human + cell-lines (all v1.1.0, matching the comment[sdrf template] columns). All required columns are present, including cellosaurus accession, age, sex, disease, cell line and the technical columns. There are 37 columns and 18 rows, source/assay names are unique per run, and no duplicate rows exist. Missing columns are recommended or optional only.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check verified 14 of 14 controlled terms (0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps). MS:1002523 Q Exactive HF, MS:1001251 Trypsin, MS:1000422 HCD, UNIMOD:4/35, PRIDE:0000627 DDA, DTT/IAA PRIDE terms. Cellosaurus CVCL_0546 = SW480 was resolved live: DI NCIt C4349 Colon adenocarcinoma, SX Male, AG 51Y.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol and paper Methods (PMC9109347): triplicate T25 flasks, 10 nM R9VH36 or gefitinib for 1 h, DTT/IAA, trypsin. PD 2.4 SEQUEST settings: 20 ppm / 0.01 Da, Carbamidomethyl C fixed, Oxidation M variable. I range-read the RAW headers of con1_cyt1 and gefitinib3_cyt2: method 115min_top6maxms2 on Q Exactive HF, Full MS scan range 400 to 1400 m/z, HCD NCE 27. The SDRF scan range follows the RAW files, not the paper text (400-1600).

file_mapping.evidence: files.json (projectAccessions=PXD033149) lists 18 RAW files plus one mzML (PEAK) and one mzid.gz (RESULT). All 18 RAW filenames appear exactly once in comment[data file]. There are no extras, duplicates or non-raw entries.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 9 source names (con/VH3b/gefitinib x biorep1-3), each with 2 assays (cyt1/cyt2 -> technical replicate 1/2), giving 18 runs. This matches the paper's 'across all runs; n = 18'. factor value[treatment] equals characteristics[treatment] in every row. Label-free, a single fraction, with no confounding batch column implied by the evidence.

omission_safety.evidence: Every value traces to PRIDE, the paper, Cellosaurus or the RAW headers. Two inferences remain, technical replicates from the cyt1/cyt2 filename suffix and 'untreated' for 'con'; both are reasonable and disclosed or minor. The 10 nM/1 h versus IC50 conflict is disclosed in the manifest limitations. No per-sample values were inferred from cohort summaries.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines: exit 0, warnings only (3 free-text treatment values not in ncit/efo). sdrf-tools check: CLEAN, exit 0. sdrf-tools score: 98/100, exit 0. sdrf-tools schema-check evidence.json: valid, exit 0.

findings.location: characteristics[treatment] / factor value[treatment], all treated rows
findings.message: The dose and duration of 10 nM for 1 h come from the proteomics Methods. The same paper also says 'The IC50 of testing samples was used in the proteomics analysis' (527 nM R9VH36 / 13.31 uM gefitinib), so the dose is ambiguous at the source.
findings.evidence: manuscript.txt lines 21 and 23. The producer disclosed this in the manifest limitations, and keeping 10 nM / 1 h from the explicit sample-prep text is defensible.

findings.message: 'untreated' is inferred from the 'con' filename. The paper never describes the control arm, and the drugs were delivered in PBS (nanobody) or DMSO (gefitinib), so this may have been a vehicle control. 'control' would be a safer value; alternatively, record the inference.
findings.evidence: manuscript.txt has no description of the control group. Files are named *_con{1,2,3}_*.

findings.message: Several recommended columns are absent. characteristics[cellosaurus name] (SW480) and characteristics[culture medium] (EMEM, stated in Methods) could be added from the evidence. characteristics[ancestry category], passage number ('p7' in the filenames is unconfirmed) and storage temperature are also missing.
findings.evidence: cell-lines and human template YAMLs mark these columns recommended. sdrf-tools score lists ancestry category and cellosaurus name. manuscript.txt line 17 names EMEM.

findings.message: The paper's MS text (top10, 70,000 resolution, m/z 400-1600, 15 s dynamic exclusion) disagrees with the RAW instrument method (top6, 60,000, 400-1400 m/z, 45 s, NCE 27). The SDRF correctly follows the RAW files. Optionally add comment[collision energy] 27 NCE from the RAW header.
findings.evidence: UTF-16 method text in the first 4 MB of con1_151111_cyt1.raw and gefitinib3_151111_cyt2.raw. PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol and manuscript line 25.
